rationale: Best run (md5 recipe: AREA 3, ABC buffering+sizing, timing-driven placement, both post-GRT repairs, cap213) is limited at ss 100C by an I/O path: reg-to-reg had +0.18 ns at 8.44 ns but the port path stayed at -0.48 ns after repair. Hold, slew/cap (0 vs bar 850) and DRC have ample headroom. Port paths grow with pin-to-logic wire length and clock latency, and the large-die bm64 run (util 21) had a slower port path than md5, so both proposals keep the md5 recipe but shrink the die (util 38 and 44), with larger setup margins to keep repair pushing. Targets of 8.5 and 8.33 ns sit near the expected achievable period, so T_eff should survive the re-check.
